thread:
rachel: Heads-up, opening a small docs PR to add a compact packet-flow ASCII diagram and a short preflight checklist for Private installer HSM networking. We've had repeated support tickets where blanket SNAT causes HSM audit failures. Need a quick docs review.

noah: please include both iptables and nftables variants and show rule order. Also add a one-line preflight that checks ip_forward, route, and cert validity.

rachel: pasted the proposed snippets: iptables (exempt HSM subnet): ```sh
# insert RETURN before MASQUERADE to exempt HSM subnet
iptables -t nat -I POSTROUTING 1 -s 10.50.0.0/16 -d 172.20.80.0/24 -j RETURN
iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o eth0 -m comment --comment "egress" -j MASQUERADE
``` nftables (accept then masquerade): ```nft
table ip nat {
  chain postrouting { type nat hook postrouting priority 100; ip saddr 10.50.0.0/16 ip daddr 172.20.80.0/24 accept; oifname "eth0" masquerade comment "egress" }
}
```

jana: nit: change "preserve src" to "preserve source IP for HSM audit logs". Also add chrony hint for sealed installs: point to local NTP appliance, avoid public pools.

rachel: added preflight checklist to PR: ```sh
sysctl -n net.ipv4.ip_forward || echo "ERROR: ip_forward disabled"
ip route get 172.20.80.10 || echo "WARN: no route to HSM"
date -u && timedatectl show -p NTPSynchronized || echo "WARN: clock unsynced"
# quick NAT check
iptables -t nat -S | grep -E "MASQUERADE|RETURN" || true
nft list ruleset | grep -E "masquerade|postrouting" || true
```

noah: add a tiny Go SDK snippet showing TLS client cert usage (ops teams prefer Go). Also include test-netns script so devs can emulate routing locally.

rachel: added Go example and test script in PR comments. CI (ci-bot): lint OK, linkcheck flagged one old HSM URL. Replaced with /integrations/hsm/pkcs11/.

ci-bot: PR #22102 updated by rachel  diff: +28 -6 reviewers assigned: noah, jana

jana: looks good from docs. If infra signs off on the rule ordering I'll merge. Can we also include the ASCII packet diagram inline? Even 3 lines helps.

rachel: added diagram and an issue to add a proper SVG in the next sprint. Merging after infra quick review. Thanks! :shipit:
